title: Module sheaf exactness from basis sections
statement: Let X be a scheme and B a basis of open subsets of X: every point of every open W has a neighbourhood U∈B contained in W. Let F,G,H be sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and i:F→G, q:G→H morphisms. Suppose for every U∈B the maps on sections i_U and q_U form an exact sequence of additive abelian groups, with i_U injective and q_U surjective. Then i followed by q is zero, i is a monomorphism and q is an epimorphism in the category of O_X-module sheaves, and for every proof h:i followed by q=0 the resulting short complex is exact.

source.place: Modules Section 01AF and Lemma 01AG, local lifting criterion for exactness

proof.text: For each W, use all basis opens U contained in W as an indexed cover. Naturality transports the composite and equality of sections to this cover. The composite vanishes on the cover because each sectionwise sequence is exact. Sheaf separation makes the composite zero on W. Likewise, if i_W(s)=i_W(t), injectivity on every basis member makes s and t agree on the cover, hence on W. Pointwise injectivity gives categorical monicity.

source.place: Modules Section 01AF and Lemma 01AG, local lifting criterion for exactness

proof.text: Surjectivity of q on each member of the basis cover lifts any section of H locally. Apply the epi clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting]. For a section s of G killed by q, naturality makes its restriction to each basis member lie in the kernel there. Sectionwise exactness supplies a local lift through i. Apply the exactness clause of the same local lifting theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exactness_of_basis_sections
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Set X.Opens) (hB : Opens.IsBasis B)
    (F G H : X.Modules) (i : F ⟶ G) (q : G ⟶ H)
    (hsections : ∀ U ∈ B,
      Function.Injective (i.val.app (op U)) ∧
      Function.Exact (i.val.app (op U)) (q.val.app (op U)) ∧
      Function.Surjective (q.val.app (op U))) :
    (i ≫ q = 0) ∧ Mono i ∧ Epi q ∧
      (∀ h : i ≫ q = 0, (ShortComplex.mk i q h).Exact)
